name: Default
shortDescription: Prometheus Alertmanager that deduplicates, groups and routes alerts to receivers, with silences and notification state kept on a persistent volume.

alerts.message: Alertmanager has no login: anyone who can reach the domain can view alerts and create silences. Protect it with basic auth through a web config file or restrict access.
The shipped alertmanager.yml routes every alert to an empty receiver. Edit it to add your email, Slack, webhook or other receivers, then point Prometheus at this Alertmanager.
